name: Warm Cache & Living Loop
description: Living continuity for OpenClaw: append-only conversation stream, warm working state injected into the prompt, and a silence-gated initiative watcher. One master switch turns the whole mechanism on or off.

enabled.title: Enable the whole mechanism
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, nothing is logged, injected, or pinged: the stream is not written, no working state is added to the prompt, and the presence watcher always returns fire=false without a model call.

stream.title: Layer 1 — conversation stream
stream.description: Append-only JSONL journal of what was actually said, written without a model call.

enabled.title: Write the conversation stream
enabled.description: Append inbound and outbound messages to memory/stream/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl. Disable to stop writes while keeping the rest of the mechanism on.

maxContent.title: Maximum characters per message
maxContent.description: Longer messages are truncated with a marker. Media contents are never copied.

liveState.title: Layer 2 — warm working state
liveState.description: Inject memory/live/MEMORY.md at the start of each turn so a fresh session knows where the conversation stopped.

enabled.title: Inject working state into the prompt
enabled.description: Adds the live state file as context before the model runs. No extra model call.

maxBytes.title: Maximum injected size (bytes)
maxBytes.description: The tail of the file is kept when it is longer than this.

presence.title: Layer 4 — continuous presence
presence.description: Silence-gated initiative: the watcher decides without a model call and wakes the agent only when a message is appropriate.

enabled.title: Allow the presence watcher to fire
enabled.description: When off, the gate returns fire=false immediately, so the scheduled job costs nothing and never sends a message.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. Europe/Moscow) used for quiet hours and morning windows.

silenceHours.title: Silence before a ping (hours)
silenceHours.description: How long the owner must be quiet before the agent may speak first.

minGapHours.title: Minimum gap between pings (hours)
minGapHours.description: Hard cooldown between two initiative messages, even if silence continues.

weekdayStartHour.title: Weekday: earliest hour
weekdayStartHour.description: Quiet hours end at this hour on working days.

weekendStartHour.title: Weekend/holiday: earliest hour
weekendStartHour.description: Quiet hours end at this hour on weekends and public holidays.

nightStartHour.title: Night: latest hour
nightStartHour.description: Quiet hours begin at this hour every day.

consolidation.title: Layer 5 — consolidation
consolidation.description: Periodic rewrite of the working state from the stream. Off by default; the agent still updates the file on request.

enabled.title: Allow scheduled consolidation
enabled.description: Reserved for the scheduled consolidation pass. Manual updates are always allowed.
